svg.title: SimCLR temperature softmax for one anchor
svg.desc: An anchor has one positive and four negative in-batch views. Fixed illustrative cosine similarities are converted to a softmax. Lowering temperature from one to 0.2 sharpens the probability assigned to the strongest match; gray outlines show the high-temperature baseline.
svg.text: Fixed cosine scores: 0.8, 0.4, 0.1, −0.2, −0.4 · schematic, not training data
